newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 108.3 Feb 14 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 108.3 Feb 14 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 108.3 in the week ended February 14 from a revised 107.9 the prior week, ECRI said.
The growth rates of real estate loans rose and the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries narrowed, pushing the FIG higher, ECRI said.

"The FIG is now at its highest level in almost a year, and its smoothed growth rate is at a 21-month high," ECRI said. "The FIG is now in the region where it is increasingly important to closely monitor its movements."
